inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One out of four children's files evaluated lacked a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: An infant was observed sleeping in a bouncer for at least twenty minutes.    Note: The director did move the infant when she entered the room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of four children's files evaluated lacked contact information for the emergency contact.    Note: This was corrected when the director obtained the information during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers were last serviced July 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant feeding instruction had not been updated in the past thirty days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of four children's records evaluated lacked an address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The wooden gate on the playground is broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies were not complete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: One fire extinguisher was last serviced July 2022 and another fire extinguisher was last serviced June 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: A child was observed using a tablet during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: One out four personnel records evaluated lacked pre-service training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: 746.1301(a)(1)A - Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: One out of four personnel records evaluated lacked orientation to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: 746.1301(a)(1)A - Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)A - Training Requirements )

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on information gathered, a caregiver failed to use good judgement when a child was exposed outside without clothing on while being cleaned up from a potty accident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One out of four children's files evaluated lacked an updated shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The permit holder did not follow probation condition #7, which requires the director to spend at least 2 hours per month observing caregivers in each classroom with a minimum of 30-minute increments. The director only spent one hour for September observing caregivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Two out of three infant feeding instructions have not been updated in the past thirty days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Safety straps were not used on a toddler who was seated in a table chair eating lunch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguishers have not been serviced since May 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 13 month old was observed with a 48 month old. There is more than an 18 month difference between the youngest child (13 month old) and the oldest child (48 month old) in the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver briefly stepped out of the classroom to answer the front door. In addition, one infant was observed sleeping in the front classroom alone while another caregiver had stepped into the kitchen.     Note: This was corrected when the caregivers went into their classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One out of four personnel files lacked current First Aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based upon evidence collected during the DFPS investigation, it was determined that neglectful supervision occurred when a child exited the operation through the front door and was gone for approximately ten minutes, having crossed a road before being found by a neighbor who alerted the operation of her whereabouts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon evidence collected during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver was laying down with her back to a child during naptime, which led to the child exiting the operation without the caregiver's knowledge.     In addition, the caregiver was observed laying down on the classroom floor during this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: RECITE: One infant was lacking written feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The Director failed to utilize tools provided by Child Care Regulation to assist in evaluation of the center by utilizing checklists, resulting in non-compliance at the time of review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no written feeding instructions for any of the infants not on table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Based on information gathered during the investigation, a six week old was allowed to sleep in a swing for approximately thirty minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: Based on information gathered, an infant was placed in a crib with a boppy pillow, blanket, and toy in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: During the inspection, a child was observed briefly leaving the Pre-K classroom to walk to the bathroom to throw a piece of trash away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The consumer product safety recall was last certified May 2021.    Note: This was corrected when the director certified the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Notification of Change in Space: The operation failed to notify licensing of a space of infant space.    Note: This was corrected during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notification of Change in Space (26 TAC §746.301(2))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: A ten month old was observing sleeping in a swing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 13 month old was observed with 36 month olds. There is more than an 18 month difference between the youngest child (13 month old) and the oldest child (36 month old).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed three people to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Three children were observed in high chairs. Safety straps were not used.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: A caregiver briefly stepped out of the classroom three separate times, therefore supervision was not appropriate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
